title: Audiobook subtitles
intro: Generate SRT subtitles for audiobooks in your library with faster-whisper. Subtitles are written next to each audio file with the same name, so the MyBooks player picks them up automatically. Dependencies and models live in the data volume, not in this tool package.
envPipPlaceholder: pip index (empty = container default, e.g. https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/)
envHint: Dependencies are installed to /data/toolbox/audiobook_srt/deps/<py-platform>/ and models to models/. Tool updates never reinstall or re-download them. First install is about 250–350 MB.
modelsHint: Models are large; download on demand. On ARM CPU, small is the everyday choice.
promptPlaceholder: Optional. For Chinese: 以下是普通话有声书内容，请使用规范标点。
optionsHint: "Missing only" skips files that already have subtitles; "Re-transcribe all" / "Manual selection" rewrite same-name .srt files (existing .vtt files are not deleted). Options apply to the next run only; use Save as default to keep them.
footerHint: Only same-name .srt files are written next to the audio; audio and metadata are untouched. Files are written atomically.
alertDepsMissing: Transcription dependencies are missing. Use Install dependencies above first.
alertNoModel: No model available. Download one first (small is recommended on ARM CPU).
confirmDeleteModel: Delete model {name}? It will need to be downloaded again.
modelNote.tiny: Only for smoke tests; poor quality
modelNote.large-v3: Best Chinese quality; may be slower than realtime on ARM CPU
purgeHint: Deletes Python dependencies and all models from the data volume. Subtitles, audio, job history and config are untouched. You will need to install/download again before the next run.
confirmPurge: Remove dependencies ({deps}) and models ({models})? This cannot be undone. Subtitle files are not affected.
